Biyang Biyang Baby Boom series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Biyang Baby Boom FZ-10 Fuzz Star Published on October 29, 2009 Biyang Baby Boom series fuzz pedal Information Biyang FZ-10 inheritates all good points of its orifinal protoype FZ-7. For sound, no noisy at all, smooth sounding fuzz distortion is in every settings, supplying 3 kinds of FUZZ too,ery punchy and alive. You can get nasty if you put everything in 5 o'clock position. Using a Tube amp, sound will get warm, very blues and jazzy sounding. Think Eric Johnson! Product Features: German-Made "Wima" Capacitor High Accuracy Resistance Metal Potentiometer Heavy Duty Footswitch TRUE BYPASS Circuitry Stable S-006/6F22 9V power suppliers(can be powered by 9v PP3 battery or regular "Boss" style DC 9v adaptor) Unique Design For Back Batter Cover Vintage Analog Sounds Standard Size Aluminium-Cast Enclosure (Colored Powder Coated Chassis, Smart Compact circuit design) Technical Description: Connectors: Inputx1,Outputx1,DC9V inx1 Power supply: S-006/6F22 9Volt battery or DC9V adaptor Current: 5mA Input Impedance: 1MΩ Size: 11.2cm(L)x6.3cm(W)x6.5cm(H) Video Date ▼▲ Maker ▼▲ Video ▼▲ Time ▼▲ 2019-06-18 arielpozzo Test: Biyang Fuzz Star, un Fuzz económico 4:29 2015-07-16 Pedals & Stuff Biyang Fuzz Star FZ -10 Demo 5:29 2015-03-20 skimy90 Biyang Fuzz Star | Review en español 12:36 2013-01-10 Guitargasdotcom Biyang BabyBoom Fz-10 Fuzz Star Effects Pedal Demo 2:03 2010-06-25 Chatreeo BIYANG FZ-10 FUZZ STAR GUITAR EFFECT DEMO BY CHATREEO 9:22 Reviews myFXDB user reviews No reviews yet  + Add your review Links Biyang Biyang Baby Boom series Biyang Baby Boom FZ-10 Fuzz Star Where to find one?
